newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick Q4 net climbs on expansion plan.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick Q4 net climbs on expansion plan.

text.p: Brunswick Corp said Wenesday its acquisitions and aggressive marketing programs helped net income rise by 30 percent and sales grow by 20 percent in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
Brunswick reported net income of $29.1 million in the period, compared to $22.2 million one year ago. Sales totaled $799.5 million, versus $665.5 million in 1995.
The company said its purchase of the Roadmaster bicycles and American Camper lines contributed significantly to its growth in 1996.
Brunswick is a recreational products manufacturer.
Its shares closed down 3/8 Wednesday at 24-1/4.
